# The splits that TestSplitsPinNoDomain admits: each pins the count or the
# digest of its generated domain. A row is `path<TAB>split name<TAB>reason`;
# a row that admits no pin fails the test. Each row names the unit that
# removes the pin (test-speed plan, S6); none is added. T4 and T5 removed
# every pin, so the list is empty.
